name: context
description: Keeps durable information about the user and their work — their role and team, other teams and what they own, reference documentation, how things are run, decisions not tied to a single project — in the user's context tree, through the idion CLI. Use when the user says something about their organisation ("my team is X", "so-and-so owns Y", "we decided it this way"), when they say "remember this", "take note of this" or "save this", when a document or conversation turns up something that will still matter in three months, or when context about the user is needed to answer well.
